amendment_01.reason: Moving target: the pinned audit report artifacts/worker-025/l1_identity_audit/report.json measured a8703d304a5b at 01:12:44 (recorded above before any fetch of this task) and f5d86ddce834 at 01:14:01, superseding the 31-row FETCH_FAILED selection. No fetch of this task had run at the time of the move.
amendment_01.observed_effect: At f5d86ddce834 the audit reports fetch_failed=0, 77 IDENTITY_MATCH + 18 IDENTITY_MATCH_WITH_AUTHOR_YEAR_FLAG + 2 NO_IDENTIFIER, doi_registration_agency crossref=66/datacite=26, rows_resolved_both_channels=59.
amendment_01.decision: Keep the superseded 31 citation_ids as pre-registered population P1 (frozen by citation_id list captured from the a8703d304a5b bytes) and add population P2 = all 97 rows at the new pin f5d86ddce834. The same resolution channels, thresholds and verdict rule apply. P1 is reported separately from P2.

amendment_02.reason: Second move of the same live path: f5d86ddce834 measured 01:14:01, 5bd6b3263fea measured 01:15:04 (bytes 122782 -> 122885; summary counts unchanged: 77/18/2, fetch_failed 0, crossref 66 / datacite 26, both channels 59). Still no fetch of this task had run.
amendment_02.decision: Freeze a byte copy at 5bd6b3263fea under artifacts/worker-007/l1_resolver_channel/snapshot/worker-025_l1_identity_audit_report.5bd6b3263fea.json and measure against the snapshot. A moving live path can no longer abort or silently change the comparison; the measured live-path hashes are logged in drift_log.json. The ledger ledger/citation_audit.csv is not snapshotted for execution: it is read from its canonical path and any move aborts the run, because it is the artifact whose identity is being audited.

selection_rule: All rows of the pinned audit report whose verdict field equals the literal string 'FETCH_FAILED' (31 rows). Selected before any network access of this task.

doi: https://api.crossref.org/works/{doi} (DOI case preserved exactly as declared in the ledger, no lowercasing)
https://api.datacite.org/dois/{doi} (consulted for every DOI, not only on Crossref miss)
resolution_channels.arxiv: https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?id_list={ids} in chunks of 20, entry keys accepted in both display forms ('gr-qc/0307013' and '0307013') and with or without a vN suffix

verdict_rule.RESOLVED_COMPATIBLE: at least one channel returns a title and max(jaccard, ratio) against the declared CSV title meets the frozen thresholds
verdict_rule.RESOLVED_INCOMPATIBLE: at least one channel returns a title but none meets the frozen thresholds
verdict_rule.UNRESOLVED: no channel returns a title, though the row declares a DOI or arXiv id
verdict_rule.NO_IDENTIFIER: the row declares neither a DOI nor an arXiv id

pre_registered_falsifier: Re-run resolve_l1_residue.py --offline on the shipped cache and obtain a different per-row verdict set or summary counts; or show a row whose DataCite/Crossref/arXiv record carries a title that contradicts the declared title beyond the frozen thresholds while this report marks it RESOLVED_COMPATIBLE.
controls: C1 positive: known-good Crossref DOI 10.4007/annals.2023.198.1.3 resolves and is title-compatible with the SRC-002 declared title
C2 negative: non-existent DOI 10.9999/this-doi-does-not-exist-007 returns no record at either agency
C3 threshold negative: declared SRC-002 title vs 'Naked singularities for the Navier-Stokes equations' is NOT compatible under the frozen rule
C4 determinism: --offline rebuild of report.json is byte-identical to the live report
C5 legacy arXiv id: 'gr-qc/0307013' resolves to a title compatible with the SRC-007 declared title
non_claims: identifier/metadata identity only; this task does not verify that any cited theorem is stated or proved in the cited source (rubric HF-03 is not adjudicated)
no gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status=passed, no ledger write; the audit report under test is not modified
the exact_locator evidence-hygiene defect recorded by worker-025 at the same ledger hash is out of scope and is neither re-measured nor cleared here
